According to the [ZBiotics FAQ](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1_N69ypA5d1vGCLp-I9QbkoA7bzArdfu5_cQdYwhDxdumEsVoXHSy6QBPwI_y_bqXKBek2D5rnA5MfbeT79vG4xoBGBBP_w_W4fXIWEUKO3DoREw9QkWIyzJVpxQeeHFso3H-dyxYA8lWcyjCd8NScDjmXCEgBWXcm86QAZk-WRLt8OiSQg1N2LQghmA16kosg-ZFs3wV86s) , orders typically arrive with at least 12 months of shelf life remaining, and you can check the **BB (Best-By)** or **USE BY** date printed on the bottle or box.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHEIkXXax1hWNZk7J6MI-4bWKP5p8vtmKFQTfL_TWExy9W9yigmdt4mtYOlRShE4Nr7cbQnT6xVyucDSpHNHZi4lE6h9vd3_7NGGuD799uvs3S8osjqWWAvNAe-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESyAEBxCJF1_ndzP1J5SdDcQlYRnuRbDjb2Q0Z0bxbAmO-nx7wIiQw5b9pyXSlhHo1MF5f7HCvpPvY4SruGvRWpXsD6OsukZFt0_DQJ4_pWod7HJbLGNkOE0hc6URVKVwwa1brsf83YycLgHVfFrgNHnOKc3Goraxk1Ltg0cqGylYmJEfW2AzZ7a2quTVCO0q67fAbp4jF8OTT6JOhD-fuaDOMpjpH10NL1j2jJgpe7EroJ_NU9D08FC9ZFMuwZI5N4-bK2ORGxi0hcg)

### Storage Tips

- **Keep at room temperature:** Do not refrigerate.
- **Keep sealed:** Leave the cap on until you are ready to drink it to avoid letting airborne contaminants inside.
- **Avoid extreme heat:** While the *Bacillus subtilis* probiotic is shelf-stable, extreme heat can eventually harm the live bacteria.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXMnOfZLQTYlMPxFMLab9rOAATQeLPSi-hlWVJAXmlUV7hnEIszakXEARQ5acZgYx_wlVO9TJcis3q8jVWhUXh48vHaXTwT10Y2_Ium_SkHndJRU9uGXWEW80-LTVVjU-m6_uSDCK8dngAuj1qFcZcpq8hKzmG-oU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHEIkXXax1hWNZk7J6MI-4bWKP5p8vtmKFQTfL_TWExy9W9yigmdt4mtYOlRShE4Nr7cbQnT6xVyucDSpHNHZi4lE6h9vd3_7NGGuD799uvs3S8osjqWWAvNAe-)
